name: Clean cut
status: APPROVED: the only approved AI Video Editor style (locked: ai-video-editor/presets/clean-cut-default.json). Every other style is EXPERIMENTAL.
description: Normal cuts, edited cleanly: fillers (uh / um / ah), dead air and clear slips (stutters, false starts, repeats, misspoken words the speaker corrected) removed, breathing pauses kept (cutMode clean; --mode light keeps every repeat and self-correction, --mode strict also trims pauses > 0.3 s); clean consistent captions. No motion graphics, no top box, no SFX, no music unless asked.

review.when: before build (one pass, word table inlined)

skipped.grade: grade-continuity: one grade, one shot, no punch-in
skipped.order: edl-order: the cut list is generated in source order
skipped.strict: creative-steering gates (motion, shot, life, look, fill, cardtext, items, panel, icons, sfxmix): no graphics

notes.air: dead-air --max 0.3: clean cut keeps natural pauses up to 0.3 s and trims longer ones to ~0.2 s (the 0.15 s default is the dense full-edit pacing).
notes.stages: pre gates run while the video renders (project-only checks; disfl, air, room and verbatim-final on assets/mix.wav, the audio the render muxes); mixmatch proves the final's audio is that mix (length +-0.05 s, envelope r >= 0.98); final gates (stale, mixmatch, finalface, aspect, content) run with post.
notes.content: content-kept: independent VAD + plain-ASR transcripts of the source and the final; FAIL when real (non-filler, non-retake) words or untranscribed VAD speech were cut, or kept speech is missing from the final (talk_30s run #6 cut 9 s of speech and passed every other gate).
notes.cutMode: clean (approved default since 2026-10-18): fillers + dead air > 0.8 s (trimmed to ~0.45 s) + clear slips (stutters, false starts, repeats not across a sentence end; self-corrections by the review, whole words only); disfl gate on repeats; air gate --max 0.9. light: fillers + dead air only; disfl gate --fillers-only; air gate --max 0.9. strict: repeats / false starts / stutters cut, pauses > 0.3 s, disfl gate on repeats, air --max 0.3.
